page_note: Page 80 is dense substrate teaching: a systematic enumeration of judges (fifth through eleventh), each correlated with a cosmic figure (Great King of Honor, Third Ambassador, Jesus the Radiance, Virgin of Light, judge in the air, Mind of Light) and a cosmic seat/function (seventh firmament, the air, separating Light from Darkness). Classic numbered-list substrate. The fatigue score's +5.5 apostolic_dialogue drift in the second half is largely an artifact of the word 'Apostles' (Jesus as Father of all Apostles, seg 20) and possibly the 'Holy Church' phrase at seg 38 — but in context these are cosmic-role descriptions inside the enumeration, not dialogue frame. The eleventh-judge unit (segs 36-39) is the only place where institutional vocabulary ('Holy Church') bleeds into the cosmic mapping; this may be an editorial extension of the Mind-of-Light's cosmic function to identify the contemporary church, but the structural enumeration itself is substrate. Heavy lacunae throughout (77.5% damage).
